messages:
Lena (sales): heads-up — NovaCore POC cutover scheduled in ~45m. They've chosen Private deployment + SAML. During smoke yesterday they hit a mix of 503s and throttles. we should stand up a quick triage.
Priya (CS): they also asked for IP allowlist and a sample audit-log export to their S3. demo scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Jordan (eng): can someone paste one of the failing snippets? curious if 503s are backend OOMs or fronting rate limits.
Lena (sales): sanitized sample from their infra:
```
POST /v1/chat/generate
Host: private.redwood.internal
Authorization: Bearer tok_XXXXX
Body: {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}],"concurrency":16}
Response: 503 Service Unavailable
{"error":"backend_unavailable","node":"gpu-3a","retry_after":0.5}
```
They said bursts up to 200 rps, short spikes.
Kai (infra): are they using our control plane for routing or full on-prem?
Lena (sales): hybrid: customer manages GPU nodes but control plane routes traffic. they mentioned SAML errors intermittently too.
Evan (security): SAML + audit logging are sensitive. confirm we only log assertion id + status and not full assertions. also need to validate KMS key mappings for their S3 export.
Jordan (eng): likely issues: (a) their gateway opening many parallel streams w/o client-side backoff, (b) control plane applying conservative per-org burst limits until warmed, (c) occasional GPU node flapping.
Priya (CS): I've asked them to send their gateway config and a short packet capture. also asked for their IdP metadata (entity ID, cert).
Jordan (eng): quick plan: 1) flip a temp higher-burst policy for org to allow demo checks, 2) route traffic to a new canary pool, 3) ask customer to temporarily disable aggressive retries. Kai can you create the override?
Kai (infra): creating override: policy novacore-temp-burst-2024. provisioning canary pool novacore-canary-a. adding CIDR 198.51.100.0/28 to allowlist.
deploy-bot: policy novacore-temp-burst-2024 created by Kai at 2024-08-21T02:05:11Z :white_check_mark: 
Jordan (eng): thanks. Lena, ask them to capture one full request/response including headers (SAML header + x-org-id) and send log lines from the gateway. we need timestamps to correlate.
Lena (sales): asked them to pause retries and send logs. they returned a SAML error: "AudienceRestrictionFailed" from their IdP. forwarding to Evan.
Evan (security): Audience mismatch means SP entity ID likely incorrect or the AssertionConsumerService URL mismatch. also check clock skew within 2 minutes. will draft step-by-step for their IdP.
Priya (CS): pricing flag — they want a short demo SLA discount if we hit the next milestone. legal needs a one-page amendment for Private deployments.
Lena (sales): noted — I'll push for a decision by EOD. demo is their hard deadline.
Jordan (eng): load testing from our harness reproduced 503s under bursty retries. root cause appears to be their gateway opening >16 parallel connections per client and retrying immediately on 503, amplifying load.
Jordan (eng): mitigation applied: soft smoothing throttle and per-org queue bump + enabled prefix caching for repeated prompts. policy name novacore-smooth-21aug.
Kai (infra): canary shows traffic accepted, GPU nodes stable. adding alert: if 503 rate > 0.5% over 5m, page infra.
Lena (sales): customer reports demo flows succeed in single-user flows but still fail under synthetic stress.
Jordan (eng): ask them to implement exponential backoff with jitter on retries. we'll keep the soft throttle for the demo window.
Priya (CS): I'll prepare a 1-page runbook for cutover/rollback for tomorrow's demo: who does what, who to page, quick troubleshooting steps.
Evan (security): on SSQ: they asked about audit log export (S3 endpoint in their VPC), retention 365 days, and KMS key rotation. I'll produce written answers and share.
Lena (sales): follow-ups: Jordan -> finalize throttle & move to per-org policy; Kai -> keep canary 24h & monitor; Evan -> SSQ + SAML guidance; Priya -> runbook + demo comms; Lena -> pricing amendment.
Kai (infra): canary live. tagging traffic with org:novacore. metrics show p95 latency steady.
Jordan (eng): prepping a tiny optimizer change (increase KV TTL, enable prompt prefix cache) in case spikes continue tomorrow. low risk rollback.
Lena (sales): thanks team. will reconvene if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): great work. I'll drop the runbook link here when ready.
Evan (security): SSQ answers attached in email, will paste summary here shortly.
